notes:
Mid-market SaaS (internal IT/helpdesk) building a chat-based assistant for employees + ticket triage. Primary focus: streaming responses + tool calling (ticket lookup, status updates, calendar availability). Initial demo on Hosted API looked good for functional behavior; streaming and function/tool calling demoed successfully. POC focused on latency SLOs (UI feels snappy) and audit/retention requirements.

Key quotes: "Can’t have >500ms tail latency in the agent UI — users abandon sessions" (CTO). "Need audit logs and 1y retention for internal compliance, legal may push longer" (Head of IT).

Technical requirements: low 95/99p latency for short-turnaround responses, deterministic fallback when models unavailable, ability to route to cheaper model for non-sensitive workloads, KMS integration for keys, and exportable audit logs for every conversation.

POC notes: Hosted API handled typical traffic but showed latency spikes at peak (stress test: 500 concurrent agents, 99p ~720ms). Investigating Dedicated for predictable throughput and VPC for audit/residency controls. Security team ran initial questionnaire (see security FAQ). SE Priya leading technical POC; next review scheduled to decide buy vs reserved capacity.

Commercial: looking at mid-market bundle; estimate $50k-150k ARR if Dedicated chosen with 12mo commit. Blockers: security sign-off, perf at 99p, final pricing approval.
